pages.title: 3-Way QuickSort in Umbra
pages.printed_summary: Standalone deck title, author Thomas Neumann, dated May 28, 2020.

pages.title: Motivation
pages.printed_summary: ORDER BY comparison logic is type-dependent and known only at runtime.

pages.title: The Current Situation
pages.printed_summary: std::sort calls a query-compiled/JITed comparator for every comparison.

pages.title: The Problem
pages.printed_summary: Profile showing comparator-call overhead.

pages.title: The Problem (2)
pages.printed_summary: Comparator disassembly and per-instruction cost profile.

pages.title: The Obvious Solution
pages.printed_summary: Weak-heap-sort implementation.

pages.title: The Obvious Solution - Weak Heap Sort
pages.printed_summary: Weak heap sort reduces comparisons but is slower for the measured integer/string workloads.

pages.title: New Idea - Generate Quick Sort
pages.printed_summary: Generate partitioning code so there is one call per partition rather than per comparison.

pages.printed_summary: Partition invariant and equal-key relocation to the center.

pages.printed_summary: Disassembly and cost profile of the generated version.

pages.title: Performance

pages.title: Performance (2)

pages.printed_summary: Branch-free Lomuto loop trades pointless swaps for elimination of loop branch misses.

pages.title: Performance (3)
